titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC. PM Andy Burnham on Sunday announced changes to the next early release scheme - scheduled to start in October - which mean PC Harper's killers will stay in jail. US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks. Iran says the attack on Larak Island, the first known US strikes since late July, killed two people and injured two others. Patel to be replaced by Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary. Kemi Badenoch is expected to carry out a wider reshuffle of her front bench team following high-profile departures. Parents of seriously ill children should get paid leave, says commissioner. Children's commissioner Dame Rachel de Souza has backed called for more support for parents and carers.
